title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
description: Rise and shine, MAC Fellas, let us dive right into a busy morning across the sector. Starting with Ethiopian Airlines dropping a massive five billion dollars on its cargo fleet and Bishoftu hub. That is a serious capacity play in East Africa, pointing to heavy long-term infrastructure commitment. Meanwhile, Flydubai Cargo just launched its scheduled freighter network with three seven-thirty-sevens targeting ecommerce. Fresh regional capacity meeting specific demand, perfectly timed as August global traffic finished the summer showing solid growth. Strong baseline demand across the board. Keep an eye on how these regional hubs scale up capacity this quarter.

sources.title: Ethiopian Airlines spends $5bn on cargo fleet as its Bishoftu hub takes shape - The Africa Report
